platform: Windows x64, Abaqus 2025 HF1, Python 3.10.5 / NumPy 1.22.4
method: Five fresh processes per variant per fixture, sequential alternating order. Saved full baseline package versus current package; writer and non-mesh algorithms unchanged. Same ODB bytes, instances, frames and PVD; bundled fixtures also export history. Imports/SDK startup and detailed profiling excluded from 30 primary samples. No cold-cache guarantee.
implementation: Replace separate label/geometry queries with InstanceMesh(name, node_labels, coordinates, elements). Traverse native nodes/elements once, store owned float64 coordinates in preallocated NumPy array, combine coordinate matrices without per-node Python row lists.
validation: All final variant output sets match baseline byte-for-byte; input hashes unchanged; eight VTK pairs match geometry and fields. Mesh identity, shape, uniqueness and connectivity validation retained.
